verdict.rationale: SavvyCal has a documented REST API that uses JSON and supports personal access tokens (bearer `pt_secret_...`), so scripts or CI jobs can authenticate and automate it without a browser. HMAC-signed webhooks also support event-driven automation. However, there is no CLI and no CI-specific guidance, and probes found no OpenAPI spec, so headless use means hand-writing API integrations. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI/automation docs or examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration.
